# Archived GitHub Actions workflows

These workflow files were moved out of `.github/workflows/` on 2026-09-28 as part of GitHub Actions maintenance.

They are retained for audit/history but are intentionally inactive. Most are completed one-time publishing, migration, styling, repair, or cache-refresh jobs. GitHub only executes workflow definitions stored in `.github/workflows/`.

Active workflows were intentionally limited to reusable QA, maintenance, synchronization, and generation jobs.

Archived workflow count: 70
